title: a decision card locks every answer control the moment the captain confirms and keeps it locked until the card settles, and the intent card reads in one fixed order: header with the kind badge, outcome and status, then Intent, How it works, Alignment, Scope, Notes, Options, Questions and the confirm button
acceptance: Why. On 2026-10-06 the captain said: '看板點擊以後應該要馬上disable, 不再讓繼續點擊, 而且現在的船長意圖卡展示的太醜了, 資訊排版弄的清楚一點'. Diagnosis on main 2428fee, board/public/index.html: answer(id) (:860-900) adds id to `sent` and re-renders, so full(d) (:675-711) renders every control with `locked = sent.has(d.id) || readOnly()` disabled while the POST runs; but on success it calls `sent.delete(id)` (:868) and re-renders from the old `latest`, where the card is still pending, so every option, question and confirm control is enabled again until the next state fetch replaces the deck; the captain can click and send again. The server already answers a repeated identical answer with `{ok:true, already:true}` and a different one with 409 'decision already recorded differently' (board/server.ts:2238-2248; covered by tests/decisions.test.sh:160 and tests/board-card-effects.test.sh:528). The layout (screenshot of a merge card rendered through the e2e fixture) is one long column: explanation, a before/after text pair, outcome, then an 'Intent alignment (STE)' block with Intent, Why, Scope, Done, Notes and Questions, then the A/B/C option buttons each followed by its pros/cons paragraph, then custom and confirm; headings are small and similar, the before_nodes/after_nodes the card carries are only drawn by the separate fm-diagram SVG, and options sit after the questions.

Change 1 - click lock (board/public/index.html). Add a module-level `answered = new Set()` beside `sent` (:334). full(d)'s lock becomes `locked = sent.has(d.id) || answered.has(d.id) || readOnly()`; every answer control on the card (option buttons, custom button and textarea, question yes/no buttons and their textareas, the confirm button) renders `disabled` when locked, and validate(id) (:851) also keeps the confirm button disabled when `answered.has(id)`. In answer(id): the confirm button's label changes to t('sending') (existing key '送出中…'/'Sending…') while `sent.has(id)`; on success (no r.error) add `answered.add(id)` before `sent.delete(id)`, so the card stays locked after the POST returns; on a refusal (r.error) do not add it, so the card unlocks and shows the refusal text (existing `refused` path). `answered` entries are dropped in render() for ids that are no longer in the state's pending list, so the set does not grow. answer(id) returns at once when `answered.has(id)` (beside the existing `sent.has(id)` check), so a second click, a double click or Enter on a stale control sends no second POST.

Change 2 - server double-answer race (board/server.ts, only if the test below fails on base). Two identical POST /decisions for the same pending id sent at the same time record one decision and emit one decision_made event; the second gets `{ok:true, already:true}` (or 409 for a different answer). If the existing handler (:2224-2300) can interleave two requests between `existsSync(file)` and the write, serialise answers per decision id (the handler already counts effectsInFlight, :2207). State in the PR whether a server change was needed.
Change 3 - layout (board/public/index.html, CSS in its

i18n. Add to i18n/ui.en.json and i18n/ui.zh-TW.json (and add rows 對→对, 麼→么, 備→备 and 註→注 to i18n/tw2cn.tsv so the zh-CN conversion covers the new headings and the existing noteHeading '註記'; the table already has 開 and 齊; rows stay unique as tests/i18n.test.sh:78 requires): howHeading 'How it works' / '怎麼做', scopeHeading 'Scope' / '範圍', alignmentHeading 'Alignment' / '對齊', optionsHeading 'Options' / '選項', notesHeading 'Notes' / '備註' (distinct from cautionHeading '注意', which stays the label inside a caution aside), showMore 'Show more ({n})' / '展開（{n}）', Existing keys are reused where they already say the right thing (intentHeading, whyHeading, scopeIn, scopeOut, confirmQuestions, before, after, sending, confirmOrder). zh-CN is derived as today.

Tests (fail-first runs only *.test.sh, so every red-on-base assertion is bash). (a) New tests/board-card-layout.test.sh, static over board/public/index.html in the style of tests/board-chips.test.sh: an `answered` Set is declared; full()'s locked expression references `answered.has`; answer()'s success branch calls `answered.add(id)` before `sent.delete(id)` and its first line returns when `answered.has(id)`; the body of the function `intentBody` (located by its definition, up to the next top-level `function`) contains the t('...') calls for intentHeading, howHeading, alignmentHeading, scopeHeading, notesHeading, optionsHeading, confirmQuestions and confirmOrder in exactly that source order, and contains no t('intentAlignment'); i18n/ui.en.json and ui.zh-TW.json both define every new key. All red on base. (b) tests/decisions.test.sh gains a case: two identical POSTs for one pending id sent concurrently (background curl, wait both) leave one decision record and one decision_made event, and both responses are ok. (c) e2e tests/e2e/board-intent-cards.spec.ts (or a new board-card-lock.spec.ts): clicking confirm disables every answer control on the card before the POST resolves (route the POST to delay 1s and assert disabled during it); a double click on confirm produces exactly one POST (count requests); after a 200 the controls stay disabled until the next state removes the card; after a 409 they are enabled again and the refusal text shows; the section headings of an intent card appear in the order of Change 3; at 390px width no section overflows horizontally; a card with 7 alignment items shows 6 and a Show more (1) button, clicking it shows all 7, a pick made before clicking stays selected, and after the next state poll the section is still expanded; the How it works section contains the card's diagram iframe or before/after text, with exactly one visible (as board-decisions.spec.ts:127). Test (a) also asserts i18n/tw2cn.tsv has rows for 對, 麼, 備 and 註. Update existing e2e assertions that read the old structure (grep tests/e2e and tests/ship.spec.ts for '.intent-alignment', '.tradeoffs', '.change-fallback', '.confirm-questions', '.gates', '.opt', '.acts' and keep each one or point it at the new element; tests/ship.spec.ts must stay green with ship.css unchanged); tests/e2e/board-intent-cards.spec.ts:18 asserts the text 'Intent alignment (STE)', which this task removes: replace that string with the new section headings ('Intent', 'How it works', 'Alignment'); any e2e text check of 'Confirm questions' changes to 'Questions to confirm'.

Design. design/design.md §8 'The captain's board': the sentence at :2105-2106 ('intent, reason, scope in/out, completion conditions, notes, cautions and confirmation questions after the before/after drawing and outcome') is replaced in place by the Change 3 order (header with badge, outcome and gate checklist; Intent with Why; How it works; Alignment; Scope; Notes; Options; Questions; confirm), and the decision-deck paragraph gains one sentence: an answered card stays locked from the confirm click until it leaves the deck and unlocks only on a refusal. The 16px rule at :2076 is unchanged. No new section at the end of the file.

Migration and in-flight cards. No stored record changes; pending cards render in the new layout on the next page load; a card answered in an old tab is protected by the server's existing idempotent answer. T-227 must be on main before this task starts (depends_on); the header uses its cardKind(d) badge.

Out of scope: a light theme, lane cards, the roster, the live log, the voyage panel, fm-decide.sh, and how answers are stored. Scope: board/public/index.html, board/server.ts (only for Change 2 if needed), i18n/ui.en.json, i18n/ui.zh-TW.json, i18n/tw2cn.tsv, tests/**, design/design.md, design/tasks/T-229.json. Any other file needing a change: stop and name it.
